chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, meaning the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.النُّورَةُ: Depilatory paste used for removing body hair
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: A purifier; something associated with purification and cleanliness
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Honorific meaning peace be upon him

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about nūrah as a means of purification?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام states that nūrah, the depilatory paste used for removing hair, is a means of purification. The report highlights personal cleanliness and bodily purification within Islamic practice and etiquette.
